cues.zh: 所以如果是这样，那我们就是在建立量子与引力之间的联系。
cues.en: So if that is the case, then we are making contact between quantum and gravity.

cues.zh: 这一直是我整个职业生涯的圣杯——理解量子引力
cues.en: That's been the holy grail of my whole career–is to understand quantum gravity

cues.zh: 以及与之相关的东西，比如虫洞。
cues.en: and the things that go with it, like wormholes.

cues.zh: 我们 literally 是从最基础开始研究量子引力。
cues.en: We are studying quantum gravity literally from the ground up.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦毕生致力于理解量子引力，而
cues.en: Einstein committed his life to arrive to some understanding of quantum gravity, and

cues.zh: 近一个世纪后的今天，我们走到了这里。
cues.en: here we are almost a century later.

cues.zh: 我真希望他能活着看到这一切，因为我想知道他会怎么说。
cues.en: I wish he was alive to see this because I would like to know what he would say.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦会怎么说？他会说：“ER = EPR。我早告诉过你们。1935年我就知道了。”
cues.en: What would have Einstein said? He would've said, “ER = EPR. I told you. I knew that in 1935.”

cues.zh: 但他并没有。
cues.en: But he didn't.

cues.zh: 我认为这是支持 ER = EPR 的具体实验证据。
cues.en: I think this is concrete experimental evidence for ER = EPR.

cues.zh: 从实验角度看，向量正指向这个方向。
cues.en: The vector is pointing right from the experimental point of view.

cues.zh: 这是对量子纠缠
cues.en: This is a confirmation–a direct exploration–of this connection between quantum entanglement

cues.zh: 与空间如何编织在一起、如何维系自身之间联系的一种确认——一次直接的探索。
cues.en: on the one hand and the way space is knit together and holds itself together.

cues.zh: 随着 Google 构建出能力越来越强的量子计算机，我们最终
cues.en: As Google builds more and more capable quantum computers, we will eventually

cues.zh: 将能进入一个我们甚至不知道如何预测会发生什么的领域。
cues.en: be able to get this into a regime where we don't even know how to predict what's going to happen.

cues.zh: 我想会有数百位物理学家同行
cues.en: And I think we're going to have hundreds of my fellow physicists

cues.zh: 开始写论文，探讨你还能想到的
cues.en: now writing papers about all the other things you can think about

cues.zh: 其他可以做的东西——既然我们把这扇门稍微打开了一点。
cues.en: doing now–now that we've sort of got this door a little bit open.

cues.zh: 就像物理学中一贯的那样，当你能探索一个新前沿时，
cues.en: And as always in physics, when you are able to explore a new frontier,

cues.zh: 就会出现意想不到的发现。就像你建造
cues.en: there will be discoveries that weren't anticipated. Just like when you build a

cues.zh: 更强大的加速器来研究粒子碰撞，或者更强大的望远镜来
cues.en: more powerful accelerator to study particle collisions or a more powerful telescope to

cues.zh: 观察更遥远的宇宙，更强大的量子计算机将
cues.en: look at the more distant universe, a more powerful quantum computer will be

cues.zh: 能够研究我们以前从未观测过的高度纠缠物质。
cues.en: able to study highly entangled matter that we've never been able to look at before.

cues.zh: 由于与量子紧密相关，我们将学到很多。
cues.en: Being very close with quantum, we're going to learn a lot.

cues.zh: 利用这些想法可以探索的问题太多了。
cues.en: There’s so many questions that one could explore using these ideas.

cues.zh: 我认为最令人兴奋的是那些我们尚且无法提出的问题。
cues.en: And I think most exciting are the questions that we can’t yet pose.
